meta_description: S Thomas Decorators offers professional interior and exterior painting across Southampton. Expert finishes, reliable service. Get your free quote today.
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. Free quotes, reliable timescales, meticulous attention to detail.
services_subhead: From single-room repaints to full house transformations, we handle residential and commercial projects with the same precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Room-by-room repaints, feature walls, and colour consultation. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior finishes that protect and enhance your property. Fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered walls — all prepped and painted to last.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Pattern matching, precise hanging, and removal of old wallpaper. We work with traditional papers, modern vinyls, and textured finishes.

services.title: Commercial Repaints
services.desc: Fast turnaround for shops, offices, and rental properties. We work flexibly around your business schedule and deliver consistent, professional results.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and fitted furniture painted to a high finish. Prep is meticulous — undercoats, sanding, and colour-matched topcoats.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Textured effects, murals, and bespoke colour schemes. We bring your design ideas to life with precision and creative flair.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own — proper prep, honest pricing, no shortcuts.
about_para_1: S Thomas Decorators was established over 15 years ago by a painter who got tired of seeing rushed jobs and inflated invoices around Southampton. What started as one person with a van has grown into a trusted local team, completing over 500 residential and commercial projects across the city and surrounding areas. We've built our reputation on doing preparation properly — it's the difference between a paint job that lasts two years and one that looks flawless for a decade.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen, we're upfront about costs, and we deliver on time. We take pride in the details: protecting your furniture and carpets, cleaning up every day, and finishing with your space cleaner than we found it. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a full house renovation, we apply the same professional standard and personal touch.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: S Thomas painted our entire house inside and out last summer. Professional from start to finish — they protected everything, worked methodically, and the finish is outstanding. The colour advice was spot-on too. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: Had them redecorate our living room and hallway. Really impressed with how seriously they took the prep work and colour matching. They arrived on time, kept everything clean, and the results look brilliant. Will definitely call them back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: Very reliable and professional. Got a free quote within 48 hours, prices were fair, no hidden charges. The work was completed exactly when they said, and the quality is excellent. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James T.
